svg.text: External Cellular-Abundance Calibration of ThermoMPNN ΔΔG Across 11 ProteinGym Expression DMS Proteins
Primary stratum: buried high-confidence core residues (RSA < 0.20, AlphaFold pLDDT ≥ 90; n = 18,825 single-residue variants; zero ThermoMPNN split overlap)
A. Discrimination of Low Cellular Abundance in Buried Core (AUROC ± 95% CI)
Across-protein median AUROC = 0.759 (95% CI 0.720–0.778); blue = VAMP-seq/abundance, indigo = surface
B. Calibrated P(Low Abundance | ΔΔG) at Child’s +1.55 kcal/mol
LOPO median = 0.646 (range 0.633–0.688); grey curves = per-protein random intercepts
